programs.title: A Stork's Journey
programs.desc: Richard is a sparrow. Orphaned at birth and raised by storks, he believes that he is a stork, too! But when winter comes and his adoptive flock prepare to migrate to Africa, his true identity is revealed and his family must leave him behind in the forest with the other sparrows. Determined to prove he is a stork after all, Richard ventures south on an epic adventure, accompanied by friends big and small, to unleash his true potential and be reunited with his family.

programs.title: A Wizard's Tale
programs.desc: From the writer of Ice Age: The Meltdown and with a stellar voice cast, including Ian McShane (John Wick, Coraline), Lily Collins (Mirror Mirror) and Toby Kebbell (Ben-Hur, Warcraft), A WIZARD’S TALE is an uplifting magical journey that is guaranteed to cast its spell on adults and children alike. A WIZARD’S TALE is a magical family adventure about one boy’s quest to restore happiness to the world after an evil wizard named “The Grump” casts an evil spell on a formerly happy land. Join Terry on his adventure, as he outwits a multitude of weird and wonderful creatures and finds friendship with Princess Dawn along the way. A.k.a. Here Comes the Grump

programs.title: The Little Mermaid
programs.desc: In this whimsical animated adventure, a mermaid princess makes a deal with a sea witch to transform into a human.

programs.title: Dreamchild
programs.desc: Ian Holm stars as the children's author Lewis Carroll in a touching fantasy-drama set in 1930s New York, featuring amazing special effects creatures from Muppet creator Jim Henson.

programs.title: Tin Man: Part 1
programs.desc: This 2 part miniseries is a continuation of the classic story The Wonderful Wizard of Oz. It focuses on the adventures of a small-town waitress named DG who is pulled into a magical realm called the O.Z., ruled by the tyrannical sorceress Azkadellia. Together with her companions Glitch, Raw, and Cain, DG journeys to uncover her lost memories, find her true parents, and foil Azkadellia's plot to trap the O.Z. in eternal darkness.
